name: graphqlQuery
description: Results of a NetBox GraphQL query, one row per item in the first list returned

ui.name: query
ui.label: GraphQL query
ui.help: A NetBox GraphQL query. One row is returned per item in the first list in the response, with nested fields flattened into columns such as `rack.site.name`. Use the GraphiQL explorer at `/graphql/` on your NetBox instance to build and test queries.
